sentences.zh: 紧凑的药盒。

sentences.en: Like the Leung twins, Davis was wearing high heels before she started
sentences.zh: 和梁氏双胞胎一样，戴维斯在开始设计高跟鞋之前

sentences.en: designing them.
sentences.zh: 就已经在穿高跟鞋了。

sentences.en: And she couldn't find a high-heeled shoe that looked good and didn't cause pain.
sentences.zh: 但她找不到一双既好看又不磨脚的高跟鞋。

sentences.en: Davis went to Milan to study a process of shoemaking called the Lunati method,
sentences.zh: 戴维斯去米兰学习了一种名为“卢纳蒂法”（Lunati method）的制鞋工艺，

sentences.en: which emphasizes measurement and proportionality.
sentences.zh: 这种方法强调测量和比例。

sentences.en: And her takeaway is this.
sentences.zh: 她的结论是这样的。

sentences.en: A heel can be really successful as long as the shoe fits properly.
sentences.zh: 只要鞋子合脚，高跟鞋就能穿得很舒服。

sentences.en: So it's not a question of the
sentences.zh: 所以问题不在于

sentences.en: height.
sentences.zh: 高度。

sentences.en: It's a question of the fit.
sentences.zh: 而在于合脚度。

sentences.en: And there's one critical point where the fit really matters.
sentences.zh: 有一个关键点对合脚度至关重要。

sentences.en: And it's called the calzata.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“calzata”。

sentences.en: Calzata?
sentences.zh: 卡尔扎塔？

sentences.en: Calzata.
sentences.zh: 卡尔扎塔。

sentences.en: Calzata.
sentences.zh: 卡尔扎塔。

sentences.en: They call it the fitting point.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为“合脚点”。

sentences.en: That's the number one critical spot.
sentences.zh: 那是第一关键点。

sentences.en: If you look down at your feet, it's kind of right before your foot becomes your toes.
sentences.zh: 如果你低头看自己的脚，它就在脚掌过渡到脚趾之前的位置。

sentences.en: So in terms of girth, it's the widest part of your foot.
sentences.zh: 就周长而言，它是你脚部最宽的地方。

sentences.en: You have to secure that spot and make sure
sentences.zh: 你必须固定好那个位置，确保

sentences.en: it's not too loose or too tight.
sentences.zh: 它既不会太松也不会太紧。

sentences.en: The calzata is not the only significant spot.
sentences.zh: Calzata 并不是唯一重要的点。

sentences.en: The toe box could be too shallow and the pitch
sentences.zh: 鞋头可能太浅，鞋跟的坡度

sentences.en: of the heel could be too steep or not steep enough.
sentences.zh: 可能太陡或不够陡。

sentences.en: There are a number of factors, but it's most
sentences.zh: 有很多因素，但最

sentences.en: important to keep the calzata in proportion to the other numbers for comfort and security.
sentences.zh: 重要的是为了舒适和稳固，保持 calzata 与其他尺寸的比例协调。

sentences.en: The Lunati method allows Martha to play around with sculptural forms and hard materials like
sentences.zh: 卢纳蒂法让玛莎能够尝试各种雕塑感造型和硬质材料，比如

sentences.en: steel and gnarled wood with hardly any padding.
sentences.zh: 钢材和节疤木，而且几乎不需要衬垫。

sentences.en: Though she keeps her shoes relatively low.
sentences.zh: 尽管她设计的鞋跟相对较低。

sentences.en: But a quote unquote low heel is nothing to scoff at.
sentences.zh: 但所谓的“低跟”也不容小觑。

sentences.en: I wore around three inch heels this week
sentences.zh: 这周我试穿了大约三英寸的高跟鞋，

sentences.en: just to try it and my feet are killing me.
sentences.zh: 只是为了尝试一下，结果我的脚快废了。

sentences.en: So why bother?
sentences.zh: 那为什么要自找苦吃呢？

sentences.en: The same twinge that makes me feel awkward about discussing high heels is the same thing
sentences.zh: 那种让我对讨论高跟鞋感到尴尬的纠结，和我思考“我为什么要刮腿毛”时

sentences.en: that makes me think like, why do I shave my legs?
sentences.zh: 产生的想法是一样的。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: It's like my
sentences.zh: 就像我

sentences.en: whole feminism 101 collegiate self like railing at me from the past being like, you've sold
sentences.zh: 大学时期的女权主义启蒙自我正在过去对我咆哮，说你已经

sentences.en: out in every way possible.
sentences.zh: 彻底出卖了自己。

sentences.en: Uh, but there is something to be said for a well-made high heel
sentences.zh: 呃，但不得不说，一双做工精良的高跟鞋

sentences.en: shoe that kind of makes your calves look amazing and puts that like inappropriate, probably sexy
sentences.zh: 确实能让你的小腿看起来很棒，并让你的背部呈现出那种不合时宜、或许很性感的

sentences.en: arch in your back.
sentences.zh: 弧度。

sentences.en: I like that feeling.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种感觉。

sentences.en: The heel is so tied up in webs of gender and sex and power.
sentences.zh: 高跟鞋与性别、性以及权力的纠葛太深了。

sentences.en: Look, I can't speak for everyone,
sentences.zh: 听着，我不能代表所有人，

sentences.en: but when it comes to the appeal of the heel, it's actually not very complex psychology.
sentences.zh: 但说到高跟鞋的吸引力，其实心理学上并不复杂。

sentences.en: Heels affect the way you move through the world.
sentences.zh: 高跟鞋会影响你行走于世的方式。

sentences.en: They change your walk.
sentences.zh: 它们改变了你的步态。

sentences.en: They make you push your
sentences.zh: 它们让你挺起

sentences.en: shoulders back, hold your head up and swing your hips.
sentences.zh: 胸膛、昂起头并摇曳臀部。

sentences.en: They make you taller.
sentences.zh: 它们让你更高。

sentences.en: But it's not really
sentences.zh: 但这其实

sentences.en: about that.
sentences.zh: 不是重点。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm already pretty tall.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我已经够高了。

sentences.en: Actually, in general, height is not as big a factor as
sentences.zh: 事实上，总的来说，身高并不是一个像

sentences.en: you would think.
sentences.zh: 你想象中那么大的因素。

sentences.en: People will often say to me, well, women wear high heels today because they want to be as tall as men.
sentences.zh: 人们经常对我说，女性今天穿高跟鞋是因为她们想和男性一样高。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Simulak again.
sentences.zh: 又是伊丽莎白·西穆拉克（Elizabeth Simulak）。

sentences.en: I counter with that and I say, I do understand that reasoning, but there are many, many, many men
sentences.zh: 我反驳道，我理解那种逻辑，但其实有许许多多男性

sentences.en: who would equally benefit from increased height.
sentences.zh: 也能从增加身高中获益。

sentences.en: And so why are they ignoring the potential power
sentences.zh: 那么为什么他们忽视了高跟鞋的

sentences.en: of the high heel?
sentences.zh: 潜在力量呢？

sentences.en: But it wasn't too long ago when heels for guys were kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 但不久前，男性穿高跟鞋还挺酷的。

sentences.en: Think of the opening scene of
sentences.zh: 想想《周末狂热夜》的

sentences.en: Saturday Night Fever.
sentences.zh: 开场镜头。

sentences.en: John Travolta is walking through the streets of New York and he's strutting
sentences.zh: 约翰·特拉沃尔塔走在纽约街头，穿着高跟靴子

sentences.en: around in high heeled boots.
sentences.zh: 大摇大摆地走着。

sentences.en: The camera is focused on his shoes.
sentences.zh: 镜头聚焦在他的鞋子上。

sentences.en: It puts an undeniable swagger in his
sentences.zh: 这让他走起路来有一种不可否认的

sentences.en: step.
sentences.zh: 气势。

sentences.en: Men tried high heels in the 70s and why didn't it stick?
sentences.zh: 男性在70年代尝试过高跟鞋，为什么没能流行下去？

sentences.en: To condense Elizabeth Simulak's research, men's heels in the 70s were too tied up in subculture.
sentences.zh: 概括伊丽莎白·西穆拉克的研究，70年代男士高跟鞋与亚文化捆绑太深了。

sentences.en: The exoticizing elements kept it on the fringe.
sentences.zh: 那些异国情调的元素使其处于边缘地位。

sentences.en: And so the men's chunky platform went out of style when power dressing of the 1980s came along.
sentences.zh: 所以当80年代权力着装风潮来临时，男士厚底鞋就过时了。

sentences.en: Men were in suits and ties, women were in suits and heels, and they still are.
sentences.zh: 男性穿西装打领带，女性穿套装配高跟鞋，至今依然如此。

sentences.en: The high heel could come to mean simply professional power, or it could come to be that female professionals
sentences.zh: 高跟鞋可能仅仅意味着职业权力，或者它可能意味着职业女性

sentences.en: are the new power brokers.
sentences.zh: 是新的权力掮客。

sentences.en: But then I would not be surprised if that happens, that men will be as eager
sentences.zh: 但如果真的发生了这种情况，我一点也不会惊讶，男性会像女性一样渴望

sentences.en: to wear high heels as women.
sentences.zh: 穿高跟鞋。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But only if they can design comfortable ones.
sentences.zh: 但前提是他们能设计出舒适的高跟鞋。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffleman with Sam Greenspan, Katie Mingle, and me,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由艾弗里·特鲁夫曼（Avery Truffleman）制作，山姆·格林斯潘（Sam Greenspan）、凯蒂·明格（Katie Mingle）和我，

sentences.en: Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）参与制作。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco and produced out of the
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 本地公共广播电台 KALW 的一个项目，制作地点位于

sentences.zh: ArcSign 办公室，他们提着油漆桶，大摇大摆地走在加州奥克兰市中心美丽的街道上。
